shared.rule: Select and deselect every playable card.
Show only friendly legal actors before actor selection.
Show only legal targets or destinations after actor selection.
Change the selected actor before resolution.
Clear card and actor selections after resolution and Undo.
Disable cards with no complete legal action.
Never execute a different action when legal actions share a target.
Preserve exact game state after reload.

baselineMove.rule: Move either friendly piece in every legal direction.
Consume only the chosen piece baseline move.
Keep card movement after baseline movement.
Prevent a pinned piece baseline move.

shove.rule: Use either friendly piece as actor.
Offer both legal enemies for one actor.
Offer both friendly actors with legal targets.
Move only the chosen enemy and never a friendly piece.
Ring out an edge target for exactly one point.

dash.rule: Move either friendly piece in every legal direction.

brace.rule: Target either friendly piece and never an enemy.
Cancel displacement cards and clear after cancellation.
Expire at the correct turn boundary.

cull.rule: Trash another hand card and never a card outside hand.
Update hand, play, trash, and cleanup zones.

drive.rule: Use either actor and either adjacent enemy.
Resolve the push and follow when the target is selected.
Follow after a normal push or ring-out.
Do not follow after Brace or a blocked push.

breaker.rule: Handle occupied destinations under Breaker rules.
Never target friendly or non-adjacent pieces.

press.rule: Push twice after every qualifying setup card.
Do not let Press qualify another Press.
Stop after Brace or first-step ring-out.

pull.rule: Use either actor and either enemy on an exact two-hex line.
Move the enemy into the empty middle hex.
Reject wrong range, bent lines, and occupied middle.
Resolve Brace and never move the actor.

vault.rule: Use either friendly piece and jump either owner.
Reject empty adjacent, occupied landing, off-board landing, and bent jumps.

sweep.rule: Use either actor and either adjacent enemy.
Offer and resolve both rotations independently.
Ring out through an off-board destination.

relay.rule: Swap at distance one and two.
Reject distance greater than two and enemy pieces.

block.rule: Place in all directions for either actor.
Keep blocks through the correct boundary.
At limit select only one replaced owned block.

pin.rule: Use either actor and either adjacent enemy, never friendly or non-adjacent.
Prevent next baseline move but keep card movement.
Clear Pin at the correct boundary.

corner.rule: Resolve extra push for pinned target or owned block.
Stop after Brace or first-step ring-out.

respawnAndScoring.rule: Offer empty anchors and exclude occupied anchors.
Offer every nearest empty fallback when anchors are occupied.
Resolve two respawns one at a time.
Clear statuses and restore baseline movement.
Award points only to the opponent of the ringed piece.
Stop immediately at five and prevent later work.

turnMarketPersistence.rule: Interleave both baseline moves and multiple cards.
Enter buy once and auto-play treasure.
Buy every market card when affordable.
End turn, discard, shuffle deterministically, and draw five.
Undo every action type and restore prior view.
Reject stale revisions without saved-game corruption.
Reload a draft and continue through the UI.

actionLimits.rule: Limit each named actor action to one use by each friendly piece.
Keep the other friendly piece selectable for a duplicate card.
Explain when no legal piece remains for a duplicate card.
Limit Relay to one use during a turn.
Allow Drive, Relay, then Drive with the other piece.

aiHandoff.rule: Show visible progress while the AI runs.
Require an opening legal board action.
Commit atomically and name actions and purchase in summary.
Return control with a visibly updated board.
Recover from a rejected plan and process error.
Run one real ThinHarness browser smoke.
